cap: Each breast cancer drug acts at one point and carries one price. Tamoxifen blocks the estrogen receptor in breast but stimulates it in the endometrium, raloxifene spares the endometrium, and aromatase inhibitors work alone only after menopause because a premenopausal ovary overrides the block. Trastuzumab causes reversible cardiotoxicity, whereas doxorubicin damage is dose-dependent and largely permanent.
